premises.text: Voice control technology currently has limited app compatibility and functionality
premises.evidence_span: they don't work with the most popular apps out there. And the second is, they limit their technology to only a few apps.

premises.text: VoiceFear integrates with 20 of the most popular apps from the start
premises.evidence_span: VoiceFear works with 20 of the most popular apps right from the start.

premises.text: VoiceFear allows users to interact with apps without leaving the app interface
premises.evidence_span: I can listen to the song without even leaving VoiceFear.

premises.text: VoiceFear's API hub enables easy integration of new applications
premises.evidence_span: the API hub is really advanced technology that allows us to integrate more and more apps really fast.

premises.text: VoiceFear can enhance productivity by allowing voice access to complex software
premises.evidence_span: it would be such a tremendous improvement if professionals could reach all the data and functionality of these products just with their voice.

premises.text: VoiceFear will generate revenue by taking a share of sales from integrated applications
premises.evidence_span: VoiceFear gets a share of every sale. We will receive 20% of the price.

value.text: VoiceFear provides a comprehensive voice control solution for popular and complex applications
value.evidence_span: VoiceControl app that lets you talk to all your favorite apps and that lets complex software benefit from our technology.
